result.title: NullTok: empirical-null token selection for training-free long video understanding
result.summary: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), mainly due to the large number of visual tokens accumulated in long videos. Currently, frame selection and token selection are two main paradigms for addressing this issue, both aiming to select relevant visual information to form a compact input for MLLMs. A natural approach combines these two paradigms by selecting frames before pruning tokens, but noisy frame-level relevance estimates can cause irreversible evidence loss. In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of assessing the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence and propose a novel and training-free approach termed NULLTOK. For every patch across all frames, we construct an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries, capturing the scores expected in the absence of target-specific evidence. Target affinities are calibrated against these same-position references into right-tail Monte Carlo p-values, which are discrete super-uniform under a conditional exchangeability assumption. Calibrated screening and a high-recall semantic guard produce candidate tokens for deterministic visual deduplication and joint spatiotemporal budget allocation. To validate NullTok, we apply it to two representative MLLMs and conduct extensive experiments on a set of video benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness under a bounded visual token budget. For example, it achieves 65.81% and 68.85% on Video-MME using frozen LLaVA-Video-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones, respectively, at a cap of 64 full-frame equivalents (FFE), without subtitles or audio. These results outperform all evaluated baselines on Video-MME under the same budget for both backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/potato-kitty/NullTok.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 NULLTOK：为每个 patch 用 64 个组匹配的无关对照查询构建经验零分布，把查询相关性校准为 Monte Carlo p 值，再经校准筛选、语义守卫、视觉去重与时空预算分配，为长视频 MLLM 压缩视觉 token。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文直面帧级相关性估计噪声导致证据不可逆丢失的问题，其零分布校准与联合时空预算分配可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/STOP 成本权衡；但其只作用于输入 token 选择，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成与使用。
